verdict.rationale: The only evidence hinting at multi-version documentation is a passing mention of 'product and version search filters' in the search configuration docs, implying Mintlify supports multiple doc versions that can be filtered/searched. There is no dedicated documentation of a versions config in docs.json, no mention of a reader-facing version switcher UI, and no walkthrough of publishing per-version docs. Missing for 10: explicit versioning configuration docs, reader-facing version switcher UI evidence, and confirmation of per-API/product version publishing workflow.
